from your_module import delete_symptom, login, check_system_requirements

        patient_consultation_request = {"symptom_code": symptom_code}

        patient_consultation_request = {"symptom_code": symptom_code}

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(True)

        # Act

        # Arrange
